queue.title: RNG-isolated one-step vs two-step ablation
queue.hypothesis: After isolating stochastic proposal generation, planning simulations, and real-world observation RNG streams, any remaining performance difference is attributable to lookahead depth rather than incidental RNG consumption.
queue.design: Use deterministic per-world/per-step RNG substreams. Proposal-generation randomness must be identical across depth conditions for the same state; planning simulation randomness is isolated and cannot affect future proposals or observations; world-observation randomness is isolated. Compare one-step and two-step under equal total cost.
queue.stopping_rule: pilot mechanics at n=6, then matched n>=24; bootstrap paired effect; continue/redirect based on uncertainty and compute-value tradeoff

checkpoint.next_action: implement isolated RNG streams and run 6-world pilot

queue.title: Three-step or MCTS epistemic search
queue.hypothesis: Selective multi-step tree search yields additional terminal causal value per compute beyond two-step lookahead.

queue.title: Parallel designer proposals plus tree search
queue.hypothesis: Epistemically diverse proposal generation improves search quality relative to a single proposal generator when tree-search budget is fixed.

queue.title: Reward and credit assignment ablation
queue.hypothesis: Counterfactual or trajectory-aware credit can improve policy learning once multi-step downstream value is available.

queue.title: Model misspecification transfer
queue.hypothesis: A controller that succeeds only when its Bayesian world class is correct will degrade under nonlinear, confounded, imperfect-intervention, or nonstationary worlds; model-uncertainty mechanisms should reduce that degradation.

dynamic_enqueue_rules: Every completed experiment must generate at least one next candidate unless a stronger queued candidate already tests the same uncertainty.
Falsification never empties the queue; it narrows or redirects it.
Do not enqueue equivalent retries without a changed causal hypothesis, state representation, reward, search depth, world model, or evaluation design.
Promote surprising anomalies and control victories into diagnostic experiments.
Maintain matched resource budgets and preserve all negative results.
